experiment: At an encode tick, compare the latest complete raw image with the preceding encoded source; if identical, wait for capture change or100ms keepalive. Keyframe requests bypass this wait; byte budget and existing tick remain.

finding: Wide-link bandwidth drops from the retained86 control about6Mbit/s to5.04Mbit/s, but unique cadence42.08/41.03fps still fails45fps. Suppressing identical encode ticks alone does not fix the deficit. No claim of cadence improvement or final cause.
